if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have delivered him who without cause was my adversary),
I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.
Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!
If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul…
But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who…
“But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.
In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.
Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they…
See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”
translations.bsb: But Paul called out in a loud voice, “Do not harm yourself! We are all here!”
translations.kjv: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do thyself no harm: for we are all here.
